task.title: Check current provenance and security approvals of recovered candidates
task.input: The candidates actually reused in this round, their GitHub PRs and traceable recovery provenance records
task.output: provenance-acceptance: a read-only per-candidate head/base/check/approval and unmet-requirement inventory
task.accept: 1) For each recovered candidate actually reused in this round, make live read-only queries for actual PR head/base/checks and required security approvals. Compare the current HEAD with provenance records and save the time and safe links. Missing provenance, mismatched HEAD, failing checks or absent required approvals must be explicitly unmet; never label the candidate merge-ready or deployed (E-105). 2) Scan publication copies and reused Git diffs for secrets or protected backups. Record only safe paths/counts and provenance summaries, preserving blockers for any hit. Do not copy real secrets or backup contents or automatically merge/deploy. The delivery inventory traces every source and missing piece of evidence (E-105).
